title: Weather around the world
instructions: Bir sunucu farklı şehirlerin hava durumunu veriyor. Şehirleri ve sıcaklıkları karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Here is today's weather around the world.

script.speaker: host
script.text: In London, it's cloudy and cool, about twelve degrees.

script.speaker: host
script.text: In Paris, it's raining, and it's thirteen degrees.

script.speaker: host
script.text: It's very hot in Cairo today, thirty-five degrees and sunny.

script.speaker: host
script.text: In Moscow, it's snowing! It's minus five.

script.speaker: host
script.text: And in Tokyo, it's sunny, but it's very windy. It's twenty degrees.
